demo (stand-in) → advance: I ran the new `estimate(keys, numerators, denominators)` on the docs example: 3 deals × 3 card columns, where the third column has no games. Batching the columns gives the same results as calling it once per column. Shuffling the block order changes nothing. The column without games returns None. A single block gives a value with no interval. Repeated keys raise `ValueError` ("block keys repeat"). The tests in `tests/eval/test_match.py` pass (16 of 16). On PR #68, lint and scratch-clear pass and the test job is still running. Standing in for Jack, I'm advancing because every outcome the Task asked for holds and no product decision is left open. No timing was run, because the repo rule forbids load on the Mac, so the speedup still rests on the prototype measurement until the manabot port. Before release, the PR description needs a note that intervals shift slightly from v0.2.9. Record: `scratch/demo-estimate-many-ratios.md`.
